map.毛利率 = (营收 − 营业成本) / 营收。: Compute the gross margin from revenue and cost of goods sold to support pricing strategy and profit structure analysis.
map.衡量产品直接盈利能力，对比不同产品线或渠道的毛利水平。: Measures direct product profitability and compares gross margin across product lines or channels.
map.定价策略制定时，确保毛利率覆盖运营与税费后仍有净利。: When setting pricing strategy, ensure the gross margin still leaves a net profit after operating costs and taxes.
map.监控毛利率趋势，预警原材料涨价或价格战侵蚀利润。: Monitor the gross margin trend to warn of margin erosion from rising raw-material prices or price wars.
map.某公司收入 1000 万元、营业成本 700 万元，毛利=1000−700=30: A company has revenue of 1000 (10k CNY) and cost of sales of 700 (10k CNY), so gross profit = 1000−700 = 300 (10k CNY) and gross margin = 300/1000 = 30% - for every 1 yuan of revenue, 0.3 yuan remains to cover expenses and form profit.
map.毛利率只扣直接营业成本，反映产品本身的盈利空间；净利率再扣除费用、利息、税后得到: Gross margin deducts only direct cost of sales and reflects the product's own profitability; net profit margin further deducts expenses, interest and tax to reach final profit, so it is more comprehensive.
map.毛利率下降一定不好吗？: Is a falling gross margin always bad?
map.不一定。为抢占市场主动降价会降毛利率，但若带来销量与规模效应提升，长期净利可能反: Not necessarily. Cutting prices to win market share lowers the gross margin, but if it brings higher volume and economies of scale, long-term net profit may actually improve, so judge it together with the volume-price strategy.
